name: Red Lobster Wild-Caught Flounder (Oven-Broiled Plain)
whyItWorks: Ultra-lean, delicate white flatfish broiled in the oven until flaky and tender. Less than 1g of fat per serving, zero fiber, and effortless to digest.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order: 'Oven-broiled flounder completely plain—NO breadcrumbs, NO paprika seasoning, NO melted butter.' Ask for plain white rice.
